subtype_label: Focus internal / focus inference (no given focus)
query: What aspects of their experience are Yelp reviewers talking about?

judge.implied_focus: Dimensions of the restaurant dining experience discussed in Yelp reviews (food, service, atmosphere, staff)

per_column.name: food_quality_sentiment
per_column.rationale: Captures the food facet of the dining experience with a graded quality scale.

per_column.name: service_attentiveness
per_column.rationale: Captures the service facet, a distinct experiential aspect reviewers comment on.

per_column.name: atmosphere_vibe
per_column.rationale: Captures the ambiance facet, another coherent experiential dimension.

per_column.name: staff_professionalism
per_column.rationale: Captures staff conduct; partially overlaps with service_attentiveness but is a reasonable adjacent facet.

judge.rationale: The columns collectively centre on one coherent, data-inferable focus: the aspects of the dining experience Yelp reviewers discuss. Food, service, atmosphere, and staff are recognizable, distinct facets directly answering the query 'what aspects of their experience', so focus_coherence is high. The set forms a sound multi-facet decomposition at a useful granularity, each with substantive graded values rather than mechanical text features; the one weakness is that service_attentiveness and staff_professionalism overlap conceptually (both about human interaction/service), slightly reducing structural differentiation, hence structure_quality is strong but not perfect. The implied focus is genuinely actionable -- an analyst can identify which experiential dimensions drive positive vs. negative reviews and act on operational areas (kitchen, service, ambiance, staff training), so actionability is high.
